meta.name: pre-deployment-vibe-auditor
meta.description: Make sure to use this skill whenever the user mentions deploying, pushing code, checking production readiness, finalizing a feature, ending a session, or wrapping up work. Use it to scan for architectural drift, security risks, unoptimized queries, and missing CI/CD infrastructure, shifting vibe-coded code to a hardened production-ready state.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描部署前代码,消除隐患并加固上线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常直接推代码上线,想提前发现生产风险
copy.tagline_en: Scan code before deployment and harden it for production
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often push code straight to production and want to catch risks before they hit users

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会系统扫描当前代码库和最近改动,按四个阶段检查架构漂移、安全风险、数据库查询优化和 CI/CD 缺失等问题,并对每项标注状态、证据和修复方法,最后输出带通过/警告/严重失败标记的 Markdown 审查报告。
howto.when: 当用户提到部署、推送代码、检查生产就绪等收尾意图时触发。

say.text: 我要部署了,先扫一遍代码库有没有安全漏洞。
say.note: 会检查硬编码密钥、数据库访问规则等。

say.text: 帮我审查最近的改动,列出架构漂移和性能问题。
say.note: 会重点检查 N+1 查询和依赖版本。

say.text: 部署前检查 CI/CD 配置和测试覆盖是否齐全。
say.note: 会生成或验证自动化流水线和测试建议。

howto.what_en: Claude will scan the current codebase and recent diffs across four phases — agentic governance, data security, reliability, and release/observability — reporting each issue with status, evidence, and actionable fix. It ends with a Markdown dashboard using PASS, WARNING, and CRITICAL FAIL indicators.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions deploying, pushing code, checking production readiness, finalizing a feature, ending a session, or wrapping up work.

say_en.text: I'm about to deploy — scan the codebase for security issues.
say_en.note: Checks hardcoded secrets and DB access rules.

say_en.text: Review my recent changes for architecture drift and performance problems.
say_en.note: Focuses on N+1 queries and dependency hygiene.

say_en.text: Check if CI/CD and test coverage are ready before release.
say_en.note: Verifies or suggests pipeline and test suites.
